SINGULARITY.statement: Every fact has one definition. Copies drift silently.

SINGULARITY_architectural_coherence.statement: Every addition, modification and abstraction belongs to the existing architectural whole. New work inherits its governing design grammar, ownership boundaries, conventions, dependencies and product identity. Variation is welcome; unrelated parallel systems and accidental drift are not. Assess the change in the context of the whole architecture, not only the files being edited.\n

SIZE_COMPENSATED_SPACING.statement: Leading and tracking tighten as type grows and open as it shrinks.

SMALLEST_EFFECTIVE_DIFFERENCE.statement: Structure is drawn with the quietest mark that still reads, quieter than the content it frames.

SPARE_COMMENTS.statement: Code a reader must decode is not finished: rename and reshape until the code says what it does. A comment is the last resort - one present-tense line stating a reason the reader cannot derive. Any comment narrating what the code used to be, or where it came from, goes in the git commit message instead, and a rationale that must outlive the code goes in README.md prose.
